Proposition
[Contracted Bianchi identity]

Source: petersen:page-0106 ↗ def:pet-ch3-scalar-curvature ↗ def:pet-ch3-ricci-curvature ↗ notation:pet-ch3-divergence-adjoint ↗ prop:pet-ch3-curvature-symmetries

1. ch3:3.1.5On any Riemannian manifold, $d\operatorname {tr}(\operatorname {Ric})=d\operatorname {scal}=-2 abla ^*\operatorname {Ric}$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch3-contracted-bianchi

\sketch At a fixed point choose a normal orthonormal frame $(E_i)$. Differentiate $\operatorname {scal}=\sum _{i,j}R(E_i,E_j,E_j,E_i)$, apply the second Bianchi identity, and use the curvature symmetries to identify the two resulting contractions using subsection 1.4. This gives

\[ d\operatorname {scal}(W) =2\sum _i( abla _{E_i}\operatorname {Ric})(E_i,W) =-2( abla ^*\operatorname {Ric})(W), \]

where the last equality is the convention of subsection 1.5.

□
